Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
